scope: Illustrative airborne rigid-body and bounded fin-control experiments; no underwater propulsion, CFD, measured neural circuit or validated flying fish

solver.name: MuJoCo
solver.fluid_note: External quasisteady VLM-derived fin forces; ambient fluid disabled to avoid double-counting

geometry.source_status: Biological component STL vertices are in metres (verified from actual body bounds); components.json bbox_mm is a different metadata representation. No print/resin mesh or mass.
geometry.quaternion: wxyz; body-to-world; actual normalized MuJoCo states

parameters.mass_basis: v3a functional design mass; assumed scenario, not measured specimen or resin mass
parameters.negative_alpha_rule: odd symmetry of positive per-fin CL, explicitly assumed
parameters.aero_basis: Reuse exact v3a computed VLM per-fin CL at0/4/8deg, linear interpolation; quasi-steady independent fins and assumed CD0+CL^2/(pi*e*AR); forces applied at actual quad-area centroids. No fitted stall extrapolation.

controls.actuator_bounds: applied torque<=0.01 Nm, sample instantaneous positive power<=0.02W/joint, command rate<=1.5rad/s; actual joint rate and interval-work budget separately gated, failure retained
controls.mutation: reverse drag sign must violate dissipativity
controls.stop_on: nonfinite state, any fin effective alpha beyond8deg, actual joint angle outside0.14+0.005rad, height<=0.05m; retain last actual state and reason; no teleport, clipping of states or decorative rescaling

equations.source: MuJoCo computation General framework Eq1; official docs https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/computation/index.html#general-framework

equations.equation: F_L=0.5*rho*|v|^2*S*CL(alpha)*n_perp; F_D=-0.5*rho*|v|^2*S*CD(alpha)*vhat; n_perp perpendicular to v; tau=r cross F
equations.source: Existing v3a VLM computed polar plus explicitly assumed quasisteady force/drag closure; not MuJoCo fluid solver
Engineering bounded servo, not identified fish nervous system

equations.equation: cue_i=any_j(distance_ij<radius and abs(bank_j)>threshold); local threat or delayed social cue schedules bounded bank-target response
equations.source: Inspired by measured social escape in other fish; delay/radius/threshold are assumptions, no fitted neural model

sources.scope: Stateless phenomenological alternatives; no CFD claim and built-in fluid model is not used in this experiment
Park/Choi2010 measured static forces/moments; not a calibration dataset used here
Measured escape waves in swimming fish, not airborne flying fish
Danionella social visual escape; source-only primary abstract from root, species/airborne transfer unknown

endpoint: Report actual range/height/attitude/work and local response times, paired neighbor ablation, uncertainty and all failures; no biological success probability
provenance: Protocol committed before production/control runs. Simulation versus rendering hashes separate. No generated DNA or model inference.
